comparison.objective: Hold open a 3D-printer extruder tension lever, extract snapped filament, discard it, and restore the lever; candidate adjusts and locks a shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Filament task tests simultaneous lever depression and straight extraction, followed by controlled disposal. Candidate tests hex-key alignment, setscrew loosening, counterheld collar rotation, bounded tightening, control actuation, and iterative impact diagnosis.
comparison.success_condition: Filament must be pulled 7.4 cm clear, placed in the tray, lever returned within 4°, and arms returned to start. Candidate must produce two repeatable safe stops and retain the selected damping setting under a witness-torque test.
comparison.reason: Both involve bimanual hold-and-manipulate behavior, but obstruction extraction under a released idler is mechanically and evaluatively different from calibrated damper adjustment and lock retention.
